usdRate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Australia exchange rates (70.40 US cents per AUD)

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Australian Bureau of Statistics, Consumer Price Index, Australia (September 2026)
inflation_cpi.note: Monthly CPI, 12 months to September 2026 (4.0% in August)

inflation_projection.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Australia 2-3% inflation target; CPI 4.3% (Sep 2026)
inflation_projection.note: We plan at the top of the 2-3% target because inflation has run above it in most recent years.

policy_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Australia, Statistical Table F1 (cash rate target)
policy_rate.note: Cash rate target 4.60%; last raised 0.25 points (effective 30 September 2026)

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Australia, Statistical Table F4 Retail Deposit and Investment Rates
savings_account_rate.note: Online savings accounts ($10,000); bonus saver accounts 4.80% if conditions met; transaction accounts 0%

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Australia, Statistical Table F4 Retail Deposit and Investment Rates

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Australia, Statistical Table F4 Retail Deposit and Investment Rates

dps_rate.note: Australian banks do not offer monthly recurring deposit schemes; RBA Table F4 has no such series.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Australia, Statistical Table F4 Retail Deposit and Investment Rates
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average of banks' advertised term deposit rates across all terms (not a balance-weighted average)

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Australia has no government savings certificate for individuals; exchange-traded Treasury Bonds trade at market yields (see tbond rates).

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Australia, Statistical Table F1 (3-month bank accepted bills/NCDs)
tbill_91d_rate.note: 3-month bank bill rate used as the bill benchmark; Treasury Notes are issued irregularly

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Australia, Statistical Table F2 Capital Market Yields

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Australia, Statistical Table F2 Capital Market Yields

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Australia, Taxes on personal income
tax_bank_interest.note: No final withholding for residents who quote a tax file number; interest is taxed at marginal rates. 30% band (A$45,001-135,000) plus 2% Medicare levy for a middle earner

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists; Treasury Bond interest is taxed at marginal rates like bank interest.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Australian Prudential Regulation Authority, Financial Claims Scheme
deposit_insurance_limit.note: A$250,000 per account holder per authorised deposit-taking institution

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Australia, Statistical Table F5 Indicator Lending Rates
credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap; standard credit card rate 21.24%, low-rate cards 13.49%

equity_return_low.sourceName: S&P/ASX 200 at 8,908 (30 Oct 2026) versus about 5,400 ten years earlier
equity_return_low.note: Low case: price growth well below the 10-year trend with dividends only.

equity_return_base.sourceName: ASX 200 10-year record (about 5% a year in price plus about 4% dividends); after-tax 1-year deposit 3.4%
equity_return_base.note: Capped near the after-tax safe rate plus 4 points, below the 10-year total return of about 9%.

equity_return_high.note: High case close to the 10-year total return.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Dollar gold trend and a stable Australian dollar
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat gold in dollar terms with no depreciation.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Dollar gold long-run trend plus mild Australian dollar depreciation
gold_return_base.note: About 4% dollar gold trend plus about 1% currency drift.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Dollar gold trend with a weaker Australian dollar
gold_return_high.note: High case for gold in Australian dollars.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: at-call savings after a middle earner's tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: 1-year term deposit 5.0% and 5-year bond 4.95% after 32% tax
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: term deposits and government bonds after a middle earner's tax.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Bonus saver and term deposits about 5% to 6% after tax, or lower personal tax
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case with bonus rates or a lower tax bracket.

life_claim_settlement_rate.sourceName: Australian Prudential Regulation Authority, Life insurance claims and disputes statistics (June 2026)
life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Death cover admittance rate, individual advised, year to June 2026; non-advised 90.9%, group super 98.5%; TPD 71% to 91%

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life is widely sold, but no regulator or credible public premium table by age per A$1,000 of cover was reachable.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Public hospital care is free under Medicare; no credible published typical out-of-pocket cost for a private stay found.

health_premium_table.note: Private health insurance in Australia is community rated (premiums do not vary by age except Lifetime Health Cover loading) and is not priced per amount of cover.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: ABS health CPI +3.7% in the year to September 2026; private health premiums rise faster than CPI
goal_inflation_health.note: Medical costs have tracked a little above headline inflation, so we plan 1.5 points above the 3% assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: ABS education CPI +4.7% in the year to September 2026
goal_inflation_education.note: School and university fees have risen faster than headline CPI, so we plan at about the current education CPI.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 (via Our World in Data)
life_table_remaining.note: 2025 estimates; projected = 2050 medium variant; ages 60 and 70 not published in this series

support_ratio.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 old-age dependency ratio (via Our World in Data)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio (28.1 in 2025, 36.0 in 2040, 44.0 in 2065, medium variant)

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Wikipedia, Age Pension (Australia) and Retirement age
retirement_age_default.note: Age Pension age 67 from 1 July 2023 for men and women; super can be accessed from preservation age 60

retirement_age_government.note: Australian public servants have no compulsory retirement age; no single figure to report.

retirement_return_base.note: Kept at the after-tax 1-year term deposit rate; super in pension phase is tax-free, so many retirees may do better.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Term deposits and bonds held in a tax-free super pension account
retirement_return_high.note: High case for a retiree paying no tax on earnings.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Balanced super option: bonds about 5%, equity low case
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix after fund tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Balanced mix of bonds (about 5%) and equity (7%) before fees
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Average of base fixed income before tax and equity, less fund tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Age Pension maximum rate: Services Australia and DSS pages could not be reached; Wikipedia gives no current rate.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Income and assets tests; 10 years of residence required

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory gratuity in Australia; the National Employment Standards give redundancy pay and long service leave instead.

public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory employer Superannuation Guarantee of 12% of earnings from 1 July 2025, held in private funds; preservation age 60; withdrawals from taxed funds after 60 are tax-free. The means-tested Age Pension is the public pension

dps.note: Recurring deposit schemes are not offered

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate; exchange-traded Treasury Bonds are bought on the ASX

tbill_91d.note: Treasury Notes are sold to institutions only

equity_fund.note: Also the default balanced option in superannuation funds
